notes: v315 fixes the Cold Glue Map Builder stack overflow exposed by sparse Aggregate/Station 1/3/5 layouts. Machine-slot changes now run as one guarded structural transaction instead of a full runtime reload followed by a second refresh, and the operator-selected Cold Glue topology is preserved through legacy gripper-sequence profile normalization. Aggregate/Station 3 and 5 can remain explicitly enabled before their brush objects are added. Existing brush exit-clearance behavior, the -16 inside-brush depth, APL behavior, and 3D runtime behavior are unchanged.
